continuous.semantics: independent continuous force pair in [-0.5,0.5]^2 N at every one of 20 intervals

finite.semantics: independent choice among source force pairs at each interval; not the legacy block-plan schedule

execution.source_execution_difference: The source pilot uses 100 classical RK4 substeps per 100-second hold. This task uses the common CSL adaptive RK4 step-doubling replay adapter; no equivalence claim is made.

legacy_source_case.do_not_conflate_with: continuous or independent finite per-step control task
legacy_source_case.objective: same source terminal hypot and 0.001*norm(u)*100 running cost on first 19 stages

model.domain: all coordinates and controls finite; r>0; no authored physical state-bound constraints in source pilot

objective.running_formula: 0.001*100 seconds*hypot(u_r,u_t) for stages 0 through 18; zero running term at stage 19
objective.smoothness: running norm is nonsmooth at zero force; do not replace or smooth it
objective.units: source scalar score; radius contribution km and rate contribution scaled by 100000 s

prediction.discretization: zero-order hold matrix exponential of local affine tangent
prediction.producer: analytic orbit Jacobian and offset, then augmented matrix exponential
prediction.validity: point linearization in binary64; no nonlinear enclosure or off-reference error bound

roles.off_trajectory_policy_queries: any state in the declared model domain and physical state bounds; do not restrict to recorded nominal trajectory

off_trajectory_query_fixtures.purpose: off-nominal policy query away from initial state
